name: Business School
description: Home to the University of Edinburgh Business School, hosting MBA, undergraduate and postgraduate business programmes, lecture theatres, and staff offices.

name: Edinburgh College of Art - Main Building
description: The main building of Edinburgh College of Art, housing studios, galleries, and teaching spaces for art, design, architecture and music.

name: Institute of Genetics and Cancer (East Building)
description: A research facility within the Western General Hospital campus focused on genetics, cancer research, and molecular medicine.

location.map_reference: Crewe Road South, Western General Hospital Campus

name: University Visitor Centre
description: The first stop for prospective students and visitors, offering campus information, maps, merchandise, and admissions guidance.

location.map_reference: Old College, South Bridge, Central Campus

name: Main Library
description: The largest library on campus, offering study spaces, book collections, computer labs, and 24-hour study areas during exam periods.

name: Gordon Aikman Lecture Theatre
description: A modern lecture theatre used for large undergraduate teaching sessions, named in honour of alumnus and motor neurone disease campaigner Gordon Aikman.

name: College of Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences
description: Administrative and academic hub for the College of Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences, coordinating schools across the humanities.

name: Chancellors Court
description: A central courtyard area at King's Buildings, surrounded by science and engineering teaching buildings.

name: Chancellor's Building
description: Home to the College of Medicine and Veterinary Medicine, located at Little France, including lecture theatres and clinical teaching facilities.

location.map_reference: 49 Little France Crescent, Little France Campus

name: Blackwood Crescent Student Accommodation
description: University-managed student residences offering self-catered accommodation close to Central Campus.

name: Ashworth Laboratories
description: Houses the School of Biological Sciences, including teaching labs, research facilities and the Institute of Evolutionary Biology.

name: George Square, 40 - Lecture Theatres
description: A teaching building at 40 George Square containing multiple lecture theatres used across various humanities and social science courses.

name: George Square, 55-60
description: A row of historic Georgian townhouses on George Square used as academic offices and seminar rooms for several schools.

name: Fat Cat Café
description: A popular student-run café offering coffee, light meals, and snacks in a relaxed setting near Central Campus.

name: Bedlam Theatre
description: Scotland's oldest student-run theatre, hosting plays, comedy shows, and the Bedlam Improv group throughout the year.
